A '''Missile Battery''' was a type of weapon that launched [[missile/Legends|missiles]]. 

During the [[Alderaan Civil War]], several were located on the grounds of [[House Baliss]]' [[House Baliss (estate)|estate]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

The [[Fuel City]] on [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]] had surface-to-air missile batteries as defenses, operating at the order of the air control officer.<ref name="RA">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>
